description: PipelineZ (pz): a lightweight, developer-first batch data pipeline engine for SQL-based ETL/ELT, powered by DuckDB, that can run anywhere without requiring a data platform. Describe your pipeline in plain SQL files. Bundles connectors for local files, S3, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Postgres, SQL Server, MySQL, SQLite, DuckDB, DuckLake, Apache Iceberg, Quack, MotherDuck and HTTP.
